newsitem.title: UK: Innovative FY losses widen, sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Innovative FY losses widen, sales rise.

text.p: Specialist British materials company Innovative Technologies Group Plc said on Tuesday that its pre-tax losses rose 48 percent in 1996 to 3.99 million stg, but sales rose almost eightfold to 1.44 million stg.

The company, which makes polymers for use in healthcare, particularly for treating wounds, also announced the appointment of British Biotech Plc's former finance director James Noble to its board as a non-executive director.
The group's full-year loss was slightly above analyst's expectations, but the company said it was in line with its budget.
Innovative said it now had 14 international sales partnerships in place for its wound-care products, which include seaweed-based dressings called Alginates.
"Present negotiations could potentially double that number by the year end," it said.

Chief executive Keith Gilding said in a statement that "our wound-care business is now well-established for the commercialisation phase and we expect significant growth in the sales of our products during the coming year." --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
